title: StitchVector 3.0 line + face integration POC: fully automatic B0 / B2c lines + existing face method, GPKG readback. Pushed and remote-verified before test seeds 7001-7005 / 7101-7105 are generated.
question: When automatic lines (B0 or B2c) are combined with the existing face method, is the GPKG readback a faithful, valid, editable copy, and are narrow colour bands kept as faces?
no_manual_inputs: no oracle lines, no waypoints, no protected masks; sv_lf.build reads only the image. Truth is read only in sv_lf_eval.
adapter: sv_lf.py: automatic line objects -> line records for sv_oracle_v2.write; protected mask always empty; face labels = 32-colour median cut merged at dE < 10 (Oracle 'class' configuration), tol 0

methods.F0: faces only, no line layer (reference for what the face layer alone can do)

dev_disclosure: Dev seeds 1201-1203 / 1301-1303 were already used for B2c Phase A; here they were used only to debug the adapter and the evaluation (lf/lf_dev.json). Seen on dev: GPKG readback equals the in-memory composite (0 px), strict coverage valid, no holes; edit checks change nothing outside the edited group; line-neighbourhood dE90 rises with a line layer (21 -> 35, one colour per line, known from Oracle); a 3 px yellow band (1203) is lost even with faces only because the merged face palette has no class for its colour; in the counterexample band scenes lines are drawn over the bands in the band colour (colour kept, but as line objects). No parameter was changed after the dev run.

visual: dE90 vs original on the GPKG readback: whole tile, line neighbourhood (3 px of a truth ink axis), non-line
per truth line presence: share of 1 px axis samples whose readback colour is within 15 dE of the original
line_face: per band: colour_preserved = share of the band core (axis buffered to width/2-1, >= 0.75 px) whose readback colour is within 15 dE of the band colour; axis_under_line = share of band axis samples covered by a visual_lines footprint (band represented as line instead of face)
false line length split into fill edge / band / other
uncovered px, strict coverage validity, faces made only of inferred px
edit: GPKG edit checks: recolour and move (dy 3) the largest logical group, count re-rendered pixels changed outside that group's old and new footprints (unrelated changes)
memory composite vs GPKG readback px

reading: joint, no single threshold. Each failure is attributed to line detection, face layer, or their combination (e.g. band colour missing from the face palette = face layer; band drawn as a line = line detection + missing face colour).
stop_rule: one run on test seeds, <= 10 min CPU; no code or parameter change after the first number; no new algorithm in this round
binary_artifacts: GPKG and PNG stay local under runs/stitchvector/v3_linefaces/ (pre-push hook); report lists SHA-256 and the reproduce command
